children: The one-off return of Formula One to Malaysia could generate an estimated 1.1 billion ringgit-1.3 billion ringgit in total economic output, Hong Leong IB analysts Felicia Ling and Chong Lih Herng say in a note. The rescheduled Bahrain Grand Prix at Sepang International Circuit from Oct. 2-4 should provide a boost to tourism and related services, with Malaysia's financial commitment limited to about 40 million ringgit as Bahrain absorbs the race license fee. The event's timing during China's National Day holiday could attract more high-spending visitors, while limited regional competition should support attendance, they say. The race is also expected to provide additional support to Malaysia's current account surplus through higher tourism receipts, they add. (yingxian.wong@wsj.com)
